rows.en: Debish: "...Now everything is in place...
Look at this filthy world... See how far humanity
has fallen.
Now, Goderius. The time has come
to pass judgment on these fools.
Heh heh heh... Rayblade, try to stop me...
Show me your power..."
Miyasco: "Oh! A transmission...
It's breaking into our channel!"
Ymir: "I-it can't be..."
Debish: "It has been some time... No, perhaps I should say, a pleasure to meet you,
everyone aboard the Liebhofen. My name is Bafred Debish.
I am what you would call the mastermind of evil."
Ymir: "Debish...? But your appearance..."
Debish: "Ah. This? But surely you already have
some idea, Ms. Clasio?"
Ymir: "What... are you saying...?"
Debish: "Your hypothesis led to today's result.
You have my gratitude."
Ymir: "You are..."
Touya: "What the hell are you talking about?!"
Debish: "Well, well. If it isn't Touya.
Heh heh heh... Your accomplishments are quite remarkable.
Perhaps that failure back then was inevitable.
So that I might meet you here today..."
Touya: "What?!"
Debish: "That power of yours. It is truly ideal.
With it, I can bring about a complete activation... Heh heh heh."
Touya: "Activation?"
Debish: "Heh heh heh... The day to come is near.
Until then, surrender yourselves to decadent pleasures,
and await your final moments."
Touya: "You don't get to decide that!"
Debish: "Now, enough talk.
Would you show me a little of your strength?"
Touya: "Heh! You don't have to ask!"
Arthur: "Touya! It may be a trap.
Acting rashly would..."
Debish: "A trap? Ha ha ha ha ha!
How amusing! Why would I need one?
Schemes are for opponents one cannot defeat through strength.
I have no reason to resort to such things."
Touya: "All right! I'll take you on!
Say your prayers!"
Celica: "W-wait a minute!
You're not planning to use Rayblade, are you...?"
Touya: "He's the mastermind, right?! Then
Zeifon won't be enough. I'm going even if you try to stop me."
Celica: "...Honestly, it's just like last time...
All right. But don't push it too hard and break it, okay?"
Touya: "Yeah, I know. Sorry for asking so much."
Celica: "Heh heh... I'm used to it by now."
Mechanic A: "How's the anti-field unit?"
Mechanic E: "Everything is normal. No problems."
Mechanic B: "Come on, come on! What's taking so long?!"
Mechanic C: "S-sorry!"
Mechanic D: "Injection of the shock-absorbing compound is complete!"
Leone: "Huh? Touya..."
Mechanic C: "Out of the way! Out of the way!"
Mechanic A: "All right! Once a mech is ready,
start preparing it for launch!"
Mechanic F: "Rayblade is launching first!
Everyone, stand back!"
Leone: "Huh? Oh..."
Mechanic D: "It's dangerous here. Come on, this way."
Leone: "U-um, where's Touya?"
Mechanic D: "He's already aboard Rayblade.
Now, never mind that. It's dangerous here."
Leone: "Touya... What should I do...?"
Rosalie: "Is that Leone...?
What's she doing? She seems kind of down..."

review_batches.context: Complete 72-row member: Debish/Goderius speech, transmission to the Liebhofen, challenge, Rayblade launch and Leone left in the hangar. Read every row before drafting and retained prior s_010 context.
review_batches.decisions: Bafred Debish, Goderius, Zeifon and anti-field unit follow the glossary. Keep Debish's identity/appearance teasing, hypothesis credit, unspecified old failure and complete-activation claim as his statements. Preserve all FE page continuation quotes, Touya's threat, Arthur's interrupted warning, distinct mechanics A-F and actual injection rather than installed parts. No hidden body identity or unspecified activation target is supplied.

row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o00034.l01: Moral corruption is Debish's judgment of the world, not narration confirming humanity is uniformly evil.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o00034.p01.l00: Goderius is addressed by name; do not replace it with a guessed deity or confuse it with Rayblade.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o0016d.l00: He corrects long-time-no-see to a first-meeting greeting. Keep the self-correction and full introduced name, without inventing who previously met him.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o001cb.l00: Appearance can include body/attire; do not add a host name or explain the mechanism of his form before the source does.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o0024c.l00: He credits Ymir's hypothesis with today's result. Do not turn this into Ymir agreeing to assist or knowingly consenting to his plan.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o002bb.l02: That failure is not identified here. Keep the backward reference without inserting a date, victim or experiment inferred from later revelations.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o00341.l01: Complete activation remains unspecified; do not assign an unstated target or claim activation has already finished.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o00394.l01: Decadent pleasures is a non-graphic moral taunt about the world, with the full threat of final moments retained.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o0044f.l01: Arthur's caution trails off, matching the source. Do not complete it into a new tactical order.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o00480.l02: Debish boasts that traps are unnecessary because of his strength. This does not prove the encounter has no hidden mechanism.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o004ef.l01: Neck-washing idiom rendered as Say your prayers, preserving the threat without inventing a literal instruction to wash or a confirmed decapitation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o00565.l01: Touya judges Zeifon inadequate against the mastermind and chooses Rayblade despite possible objections, not a new mechanical inability of Zeifon to launch.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o00741.l00: Shock-absorbing material is injected, not a set of mechanical absorbers installed. Material composition and numerical performance are unspecified.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o007d8.l00: Preparation proceeds by mech readiness; Rayblade is explicitly first at 62. No invented launch queue or crew rank.
row_decisions.scenario.s_011.o008ce.l00: Leone does not know what to do after learning Touya is already aboard; keep the incomplete emotional question without a new order from him.
